description: Browse or search ABS datasets (dataflows). Returns dataflow IDs + descriptive names; the ID (e.g. "CPI", "ALC", "ABS_REGIONAL_LGA2021") is what you pass to dataflow_structure and get_data. Optionally filter by a case-insensitive substring against the ID and name.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against dataflow id/name (e.g. "consumer price", "labour", "population").

name: abs_au_list_dataflows
title: Abs Au List Dataflows
